page.notes: Left margin line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed beside the lines, as marked in the text. The lines after the dot figure carry numbers 25, 30 and 35; the first paragraph's numbers 5 to 20 are placed where they stand. Dot figure: five rows of ten dots each, between "tali fermè proportione." and "Hîc decem". Uncertain readings: running head and page number at top right, "dinaricatis" (likely divaricatis), and the Greek of Mark 6:40 at the end of the Greek phrase. The last line "râ, co-" continues the previous line's "sphæ-" hyphen and is not a catchword.
